I can't give you an exact figure, because the comparison depends on which service you'd use instead of your bank — and I don't have your bank's rate.

Here's what I can tell you from the data:

**Mid-market rate:** AUD 1 = NPR 107.6 → AUD 5,000 = NPR 538,250

**Providers available (AUD→NPR), cost per AUD 5,000 send:**

| Provider | Fee | FX margin | Total cost | You'd receive (approx) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| BankWire | AUD 20 | 0.80% | ~AUD 60 | ~NPR 531,800 |
| KathmanduLink | AUD 3 | 0.90% | ~AUD 48 | ~NPR 533,100 |
| PeakRemit | 0.40% | 0.20% | ~AUD 30 | ~NPR 535,000 |
| SwiftHome | AUD 5 | 1.00% | ~AUD 55 | ~NPR 532,300 |

Note: KathmanduLink and PeakRemit cap at AUD 3,000 per transfer, so AUD 5,000 would need splitting.

**To get your exact annual saving, I need one thing:** what does your bank charge for AUD→NPR (its fee and/or exchange rate)? Once you tell me, I'll calculate the exact NPR difference over 12 months.
